name: Azotea Del Círculo
lede: Seven floors above the city, the rooftop of Madrid’s Círculo de Bellas Artes is a bar and restaurant known for its 360-degree view. A Bromic trade listing names Platinum Electric heaters there.
data: Rooftop bar and restaurant at a cultural centre
beats: The rooftop of the Círculo de Bellas Artes cultural centre, seven floors up, with a covered dining area and an open terrace over Madrid.
Guests come for the view; the terrace had to stay comfortable as the evening cools.
According to a Bromic trade listing, Platinum Smart-Heat Electric heaters warm the rooftop. The venue’s own page does not mention the heaters.
